Interface IMapItemsListener

All Superinterfaces:
ISubscriberListener
public interface IMapItemsListener extends ISubscriberListener

This listener is used to receive events related with the control list. It is used at a IEventSubscriber level: it means that it is not necessary to be subscribed to an individual race to receive its events.

Author:
Jorge Piera Llodrá

      void updateMapItem(long timestamp, IMapItem mapItem)
      This event is thrown when a map item is updated. It means that any of its static attributes have changed.
      Parameters:
      timestamp - the time stamp when the message was generated
      mapItem - the map item that has been updated.
